name: Amamiya Renji
source: A lonely shopkeeper that used to be a master alchemist in the past. He came on [url=https://vndb.org/c558]Hisae's[/url] call to Eiden island hoping to find the legendary Philosopher's Stone. [spoiler]He is also a long-lost father that [url=https://vndb.org/c341]Natsume[/url] has been looking for.[/spoiler]
